title: Conformal Prediction and Conditional Coverage for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.34887v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) provide predictive distributions for regression, but their prediction regions can exhibit undercoverage or overcoverage even when point predictions are accurate. We introduce C-USIM (Conditionally-Uniformized Score Integration Method), a lightweight application of highest predictive density split conformal prediction that accommodates multimodal predictions. Given calibration and test outputs, it requires no additional training or model inference. It provides finite-sample marginal validity under our assumptions. We bound conditional-marginal coverage gaps using distribution-estimation error and score discreteness, and examine coverage heterogeneity through percentile rank-score plots. Experiments with TabPFN and TabICL show improved marginal coverage accuracy and lower average conditional and group coverage errors. translated_title: 面向表格基础模型的共形预测与条件覆盖
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFMs）为回归任务提供预测分布，但即使点预测准确，其预测区间仍可能出现覆盖不足或覆盖过度的问题。我们提出了C-USIM（条件均匀化得分积分方法），这是最高预测密度分割共形预测的一种轻量级应用，能够适应多模态预测。在给定校准集和测试集输出的情况下，该方法无需额外的训练或模型推理。在我们的假设下，它提供了有限样本的边际有效性保证。我们利用分布估计误差和得分离散性对条件-边际覆盖差距进行了界定，并通过百分位秩-得分图考察了覆盖的异质性。在TabPFN和TabICL上的实验表明，该方法提高了边际覆盖的准确性，并降低了平均条件覆盖误差和分组覆盖误差。在固定数据预算下，将更多的观测数据分配给校准阶段可以减少（条件覆盖误差）……
tldr: 该论文提出C-USIM方法，一种无需额外训练或推理、可处理多模态预测的轻量级最高预测密度分割共形预测技术，为表格基础模型提供有限样本边际覆盖有效性保证，并显著改善条件覆盖和分组覆盖精度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces C-USIM, a lightweight highest-predictive-density split conformal prediction method that accommodates multimodal predictions without additional training or inference, providing finite-sample marginal validity for tabular foundation models while improving conditional and group coverage accuracy.
